title: Semantic HTML
description: Understanding the use of semantic HTML tags to improve page structure and accessibility.

quiz.question: What is semantic HTML?
options: HTML that uses tags based on meaning and purpose
HTML that uses only divs and spans
quiz.correctAnswer: HTML that uses tags based on meaning and purpose
quiz.explanation: Semantic HTML uses tags that describe the meaning of content to browsers and developers.

quiz.question: Which tag is used to define the main content of a page?
quiz.explanation: `<main>` contains the central content unique to the page.

quiz.question: What is the purpose of the <article> tag?
quiz.explanation: `<article>` is for content that could be independently distributed or reused.

quiz.question: Which tag is appropriate for content tangentially related to the main content?
quiz.explanation: `<aside>` is used for sidebars or related info not central to the page.

quiz.question: Which tag is used to define a thematic grouping of content, usually with a heading?
quiz.explanation: `<section>` groups related content with a common theme.

quiz.question: Why is using semantic tags important for accessibility?
options: They provide meaning to assistive technologies
quiz.correctAnswer: They provide meaning to assistive technologies
quiz.explanation: Semantic tags help screen readers understand page structure.

quiz.question: Which semantic tag is used to contain footer content?
quiz.explanation: `<footer>` holds footer info like copyright or contact.

quiz.question: Which attribute can improve accessibility by associating labels to form inputs?
True or False: Using semantic HTML helps improve SEO.
quiz.explanation: Search engines use semantic structure to better index content.
